observation: Fresh main creates and updates every durable North Star run with new Date().toISOString() timestamps, and RunStore.list orders durable runs by updatedAt, yet the public v0.2 run contract omitted createdAt/updatedAt and RunStore.get returned arbitrary or impossible timestamp strings. The repository therefore had neither contract parity nor a trustworthy durable time shape for ordinary run readers.
changes: Publish createdAt and updatedAt as required date-time properties in the existing North Star Run v0.2 contract.
Reuse the writer-faithful canonical ISO timestamp predicate at RunStore.get before ordinary readers or list ordering consume the run.
Do not invent cross-machine clock trust, monotonicity or event causality semantics.

truth_boundary: This cycle closes timestamp shape and public-contract parity only. Timestamp mutation policy, event/evidence timestamp semantics, temporal ordering and independent clock provenance remain separate boundaries.
